text:
Anya: Heads-up: ACME Finance opened a contract request asking for contract-scoped retention lanes (7 years primary ask), contract-level TTL overrides, and SLA credits if we shorten retention. Also wants BYOK + key rotation aligned to retention.
Sam: That's heavy. Do we already let contracts set different TTLs?
Marta: We only support tenant-level TTL overrides today. Per-contract TTLs = new surface.
Rohan: Operational concern: arbitrary per-contract TTLs blow up index sizes and long-tail search cost. Need constrained options.
Priya: Suggestion: offer a small set of discrete retention tiers (1y, 3y, 7y) selectable at contract-signing. Map tiers to pricing multipliers. Limits variability and makes quoting simpler.
Anya: I agree. Legal prefers deterministic options too. So retention_tiers + a contract_flag to opt into longer retention.
Ben: BYOK question: if customer rotates or revokes their key mid-retention, how do we guarantee ability to produce evidence for the contractual period?
legal-bot: Note: Contractual commitments mean we must be able to provide evidence for the retention window. If customer manages keys, we need escrow, attestation, or an agreed export/playback protocol.
Marta: So MVP splits into two domains: (A) retention lane product + billing/SLA credit model; (B) KMS lifecycle + evidence export / escrow. Both need acceptance criteria.
Sam: Concrete proposal: 1) retention_tiers (1y/3y/7y) + billing multiplier; 2) BYOK modes: a) BYOK-with-escrow (tenant provides escrowed key under constraints), b) BYOK-no-escrow (no escrow, reduced export guarantees).
Rohan: Ops needs a deterministic SLA_credit formula to estimate capacity impact up-front for quotes.
Priya: Draft billing formula: SLA_credits = base_credit * ceil(retention_days / 365). Example: base=1.0 => 7y = 7x. Keeps it simple and defensible.
Anya: Need UX wording + billing hook + legal hold interplay. Legal hold should override TTL and be auditable.
Ben: Evidence exports need to be verifiable. Idea: produce signed export bundles with a manifest and a Merkle proof for content-level auditability. Also define search/export SLAs (e.g., 24h for priority requests).
Marta: Acceptance criteria (draft): - retention tier selected at contract creation and immutable except under explicit re-contracting; - KMS mode selectable at onboarding; - evidence_export job produces signed bundle within X hours (24h target for P1); - documented procedure for revoked/rotated keys and evidence fallback.
Anya: Sketch of a simple product config record for legal/product to review:
```
contract_config: "contract_id=ACME-987;tier=archive_7y;ttl_days=2555;legal_hold=false;kms_mode=BYOK_with_escrow;export_sla_hours=24"
```
Sam: Add escrow_policy fields: rotation_allowed=true;rotation_notice_days=30;escrow_scope=sign-only. Will put into the contract template.
Priya: Who owns what: Product drafts spec + pricing; Sales owns quotes; Legal signs escrow terms; Ops implements export runner & index handling; Eng builds APIs and billing hooks.
Rohan: Ops notes: need cold-archive index for long-retention search to avoid high cost on hot indexes. Export runner should stitch results from archive, produce signed bundle, and mark chain-of-custody.
Ben: Risk note: some regulated customers won't accept escrow. Fallback: Private deployment with concierge export (we run on their keys or they run export locally). We should list this as an enterprise offering (higher price).
Anya: MVP proposal: - Implement retention_tiers (1/3/7y) + billing multiplier formula; - Support BYOK_with_escrow in hosted offering (escrow + attestation); - Allow BYOK_no_escrow but with limited export guarantees documented; - Implement evidence export API with 24h SLA for P1 in hosted; - Private deployment playbook separately.
Marta: Rough sizing backlog (initial quick triage): spec + API fields (1 sprint), billing + enforcement (2 sprints), KMS-escrow flow + legal template (2 sprints), export pipeline + signed bundles (3 sprints). ~8 sprints cross-team if parallelized.
Sam: Breaking milestones for roadmap board: Milestone A: retention tiers + pricing hook. Milestone B: escrow contract + onboarding flow. Milestone C: export pipeline + verification artifacts. Milestone D: private deployment offer & contracts.
Priya: I'll draft the customer-facing pricing blurb and legal escalation playbook.
Ben: I'll prototype signed manifest + merkle-index for proofs of inclusion.
Rohan: I'll document ops runbook for export runner, storage lifecycle, and index tiers.
Marta: I'll author the RFC and wire owners into the roadmap ticket.
devops-bot: CI passed for branch retention-tiers-spec (deploy queued).
Anya: Please respond with a quick :white_check_mark: in-thread if you can own your listed action this sprint.
